item.content:encoded:
The Wadhwani School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (WSAI) at IIT Madras is offering a range of fellowship opportunities for talented researchers, graduates, postgraduates, and women interested in advancing their careers in Data Science (DS) and Artificial Intelligence (AI).

The WSAI fellowship programmes provide an opportunity to work in a highly interdisciplinary research environment, collaborate with leading experts, access advanced computing infrastructure, develop independent research interests, publish academic research, and engage with scientists and researchers from around the world.

The fellowship opportunities currently featured by WSAI include Post Doctoral Fellowships, Post Bacc Fellowships, and the Women Post Bacc Fellowship Program. Each programme targets a different stage of an applicant’s academic or research career, making the opportunities relevant to both experienced researchers and promising early-career graduates.

WSAI was founded in 2024 with the goal of bringing together faculty members with expertise across Data Science and Artificial Intelligence to work on impactful problems that have direct relevance to society. Through its fellowship programmes, the School seeks to develop scientific talent while creating an environment where fellows can pursue meaningful research and build long-term academic and professional careers.

Opportunity Category: Fellowship

Host Institution: Wadhwani School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (WSAI), IIT Madras, India

Fields: Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and allied application domains

Location: IIT Madras, India

Application Deadline: No specific deadline is stated on the provided WSAI fellowship information. Applicants should therefore consult the official fellowship application pages for the current application status and any deadline that may apply.

About the Wadhwani School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence

The Wadhwani School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (WSAI) is an academic and research school at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras).

Founded in 2024, the School brings together faculty members with expertise in different areas of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. Its work is focused on addressing impactful problems that have practical and societal relevance.

WSAI’s interdisciplinary structure is particularly important for researchers working in modern AI and Data Science because many emerging research challenges cannot be addressed effectively through a single academic discipline.

The School’s research environment provides fellows with opportunities to:

  • Work with faculty members specializing in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.
  • Develop research projects and independent research directions.
  • Collaborate across disciplines.
  • Interact with researchers and scientists from around the world.
  • Access advanced computing infrastructure.
  • Participate in workshops and academic colloquia.
  • Develop publication records through high-quality research.
  • Mentor students and contribute to the academic community.
  • Build connections with researchers in academia and industry.

For candidates interested in building a research-oriented career in AI or Data Science, the WSAI fellowships can provide an environment for developing both technical expertise and research independence.

WSAI Post Doctoral Fellowship 2026

The WSAI Post Doctoral Fellowship is designed for outstanding researchers who have already completed a PhD and want to continue developing their research careers in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related application areas.

The programme is particularly suited to candidates who have demonstrated strong academic or research capabilities and are interested in developing independent research lines under supportive mentorship.

According to WSAI, the fellowship environment is designed to nurture scientific leadership. Fellows are encouraged to move beyond simply contributing to existing projects and instead develop their own research directions with guidance and support from experienced faculty.

Who Is the Postdoctoral Fellowship For?

The Post Doctoral Fellowship is intended for:

  • Outstanding candidates who hold a PhD degree.
  • Researchers whose doctoral research is related to Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or allied application domains.
  • Researchers interested in developing independent research programmes.
  • Candidates seeking mentorship from leading faculty in Data Science and AI.
  • Researchers who want access to advanced high-performance computing infrastructure.
  • Individuals interested in publishing research and participating in an interdisciplinary academic environment.

A PhD in a relevant field is therefore the central academic requirement described for this fellowship.

Benefits of the WSAI Post Doctoral Fellowship

The WSAI Post Doctoral Fellowship provides several benefits designed to support both the professional development and research activities of fellows.

1. Monthly Fellowship Stipend of INR 1 Lakh

The fellowship includes a monthly stipend of INR 1 lakh.

This financial support is intended to provide fellows with funding while they undertake their research at WSAI.

2. Interdisciplinary Research Environment

Fellows become part of a highly interdisciplinary environment where researchers working in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence can interact and collaborate.

This can expose researchers to different methodologies, perspectives, technical approaches, and application areas.

3. Mentorship by Leading Faculty

Postdoctoral fellows receive the opportunity to work with and receive mentorship from leading faculty members in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.

Mentorship can be particularly valuable for researchers seeking to establish independent research programmes and develop their scientific leadership.

4. Opportunity to Mentor Students

The fellowship also provides fellows with opportunities to mentor bright students.

This can allow postdoctoral researchers to gain additional academic experience while contributing to the development of the next generation of researchers.

5. Research and Travel Allowances

In addition to the monthly stipend, the fellowship includes additional allowances for research and travel.

Such support can help fellows participate in research-related activities and academic events.

6. Workshops and International Colloquia

WSAI regularly organizes workshops and colloquia involving international experts.

Fellows can benefit from exposure to current research developments and opportunities to interact with experts working in different areas of AI and Data Science.

7. High-Performance Computing Infrastructure

Researchers receive access to state-of-the-art high-performance computing infrastructure.

This is particularly significant for researchers working with computationally intensive AI and Data Science projects that require substantial CPU or GPU resources.

WSAI Post Bacc Fellowship Program 2026

The WSAI Post Bacc Fellowship Program is designed for exceptional graduates and postgraduates seeking an extended research experience in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.

The programme can provide an opportunity to spend up to two years undertaking research in an advanced academic environment.

Unlike a conventional short-term internship, the fellowship is structured around deeper research engagement. Participants can work on research problems, interact with scientists, develop technical skills, contribute to publications, and potentially earn academic course credits at IIT Madras.

Who Can Apply for the WSAI Post Bacc Fellowship?

The stated eligibility requirements are:

  • Applicants should have a four-year Bachelor’s degree or a Master’s degree.
  • The degree should be in an area relevant to WSAI.
  • Applicants should be under 27 years of age.

The programme is therefore particularly suitable for young graduates and postgraduate students who want to explore research in AI and Data Science before pursuing a longer-term academic or research career.

Applicants should ensure that their academic background is relevant to the research areas of WSAI.

Benefits of the WSAI Post Bacc Fellowship

The programme provides a range of academic, research, professional, and networking opportunities.

Work at a Leading Research Centre

Fellows have the opportunity to work at one of India’s leading research centres for Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.

This provides exposure to a research-focused environment and the opportunity to work alongside experienced academics and researchers.

Interact With Scientists From Around the World

The fellowship allows participants to interact with top scientists from around the world.

International academic exposure can help fellows develop professional networks and gain insight into current developments in AI and Data Science.

Access to High-Performance Computing

Participants can access state-of-the-art CPU and GPU high-performance computing infrastructure.

This can be particularly valuable for computational research, machine learning, deep learning, large-scale data analysis, and other areas requiring significant computing resources.

Possibility of Earning IIT Madras Course Credits

The programme offers the possibility of earning course credits at IIT Madras.

This can add an academic component to the research experience and potentially support the fellow’s future educational plans.

Opportunities to Publish Research

Fellows can work toward publishing their research in top journals and A conferences*.

Developing a strong publication record can be highly valuable for candidates considering PhD programmes, academic careers, research positions, or advanced technical roles.

Support for Top-Tier Publications

According to WSAI, any publication in a top-tier venue will be supported by the Centre’s infrastructure.

This demonstrates the programme’s emphasis on producing high-quality research rather than simply completing short-term projects.

Fully Funded National Conference Trip

Fellows receive a fully funded trip to a national conference every year.

Conference participation can provide opportunities to present research, learn from other researchers, receive feedback, and build professional connections.

Previous Fellow Experience

WSAI highlights the experience of previous fellows to demonstrate the potential impact of the Post Bacc programme.

One former fellow, Siddharth C, described the fellowship as providing guidance, time to learn, access to experts from around the world, and an opportunity to discover his strengths.

His experience illustrates how a research fellowship can potentially provide more than technical training. It can also help participants clarify their academic interests, identify areas of specialization, and prepare for further studies.

According to the testimonial provided by WSAI, the fellowship experience contributed to Siddharth’s subsequent journey toward a Master’s in Computing Science at the University of Alberta.

WSAI Post Bacc-W Fellowship Program 2026

The WSAI Post Bacc-W Fellowship Program is a dedicated two-year research fellowship exclusively for women.

The programme seeks exceptional graduates and postgraduates who want to undertake research in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence while receiving mentorship and access to advanced research infrastructure.

The programme is designed to support women interested in building research careers in AI and Data Science and provides opportunities for academic development, research publication, professional networking, and participation in major computing-related events.

Eligibility Requirements for the Women Post Bacc Fellowship

The eligibility requirements provided by WSAI include:

  • Applicants must have a four-year Bachelor’s degree or a Master’s degree.
  • The degree should be in an area relevant to WSAI.
  • Applicants under 28 years of age are encouraged to apply.
  • The programme is exclusively for women.

Candidates should ensure that their academic background aligns with the research areas available through WSAI.

Benefits of the WSAI Women Post Bacc Fellowship

The programme provides several benefits aimed at helping women develop as researchers and technology professionals.

Research at WSAI

Participants can work at a leading research centre focused on Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.

The research environment can provide exposure to advanced AI methodologies and interdisciplinary research.

Interaction With International Scientists

Fellows have opportunities to interact with top scientists from around the world.

International engagement can broaden participants’ understanding of the global AI research ecosystem.

Publication Opportunities

Fellows can work toward publishing research in top journals and A conferences*.

The Centre also states that publications in top-tier venues will receive support from its infrastructure.

Mentorship by Women Experts

A particularly important feature of the programme is mentorship by women experts from academia or industry.

This provides fellows with opportunities to learn from experienced women working in research and professional environments.

Access to CPU and GPU Computing

Participants receive access to state-of-the-art CPU and GPU infrastructure.

Such computing resources can be important for research involving machine learning, artificial intelligence, data-intensive applications, and computational experimentation.

Potential IIT Madras Course Credits

Participants have the possibility of earning course credits at IIT Madras, providing an additional academic dimension to the fellowship.

Fully Funded Annual Conference Trip

The fellowship includes a fully funded trip to a national conference every year.

This can help fellows present their work, meet researchers, discover new research opportunities, and expand their professional networks.

Participation in Major Women-in-Computing Events

Participants may also attend major events and initiatives such as:

  • ACM-W
  • Grace Hopper Celebration of Women in Computing

These opportunities can provide additional networking, professional development, and exposure to the wider technology community.

Previous Women Post Bacc Fellow Experience

WSAI also shares a testimonial from Abjasree S, Data Scientist at Datycs, who described the fellowship as personally and professionally enriching.

Her testimonial emphasizes several aspects of the fellowship experience, including the freedom to choose research problems, collaboration with experienced academics, expert guidance, interaction with exceptional peers, and development of technical skills.

The experience also highlights the importance of multidisciplinary teamwork and the opportunity to pursue research that can contribute meaningfully to society.

Comparing the Three WSAI Fellowship Opportunities

The three fellowship programmes serve different categories of applicants.

Fellowship Main Target Group Academic Requirement Age Requirement Duration/Structure
WSAI Post Doctoral Fellowship Experienced researchers PhD in Data Science, AI, or allied application domains Not specified in provided information Postdoctoral research
WSAI Post Bacc Fellowship Exceptional graduates and postgraduates Four-year Bachelor’s or Master’s degree relevant to WSAI Under 27 Up to two years
WSAI Post Bacc-W Fellowship Women graduates and postgraduates Four-year Bachelor’s or Master’s degree relevant to WSAI Under 28 encouraged Two years

Applicants should carefully select the programme corresponding to their educational background, career stage, and eligibility.

Why Consider the WSAI Fellowships?

There are several reasons why these fellowships may be attractive to candidates interested in AI and Data Science.

1. Strong Research Focus

The programmes are designed around research rather than only classroom learning. This makes them particularly relevant to candidates considering careers in academia, research institutions, technology, or advanced AI development.

2. Access to Advanced Infrastructure

AI research can require substantial computing resources. Access to state-of-the-art CPU and GPU infrastructure can enable fellows to undertake computational projects that may otherwise be difficult to conduct independently.

3. Faculty Mentorship

Mentorship from experienced researchers can help fellows refine research questions, improve methodologies, interpret results, develop publications, and establish stronger academic directions.

4. International Exposure

Interactions with international experts can expose fellows to global research trends and provide opportunities to develop professional connections beyond their immediate academic environment.

5. Publication Opportunities

For candidates planning an academic or research career, publications can be an important part of their professional profile. WSAI specifically highlights opportunities to publish in top journals and A* conferences.

6. Conference Participation

The funded national conference trip provides fellows with opportunities to engage with the wider research community.

7. Research Independence

The WSAI environment encourages fellows to develop independent research lines. This can be particularly valuable for researchers seeking to progress toward academic leadership and independent research careers.

What Kind of Researcher Would Benefit Most From These Fellowships?

The fellowships may be particularly suitable for candidates with a strong interest in areas such as:

  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Data Science
  • Machine Learning
  • Computational research
  • AI applications
  • Data-driven research
  • Interdisciplinary AI research
  • Other allied application domains related to WSAI

The exact research areas available to an applicant will depend on the research activities and faculty expertise at WSAI.

Candidates should therefore review the School’s research areas and faculty profiles before applying and identify research interests that align with the Centre’s work.

How to Apply for the WSAI Fellowships 2026

WSAI provides separate application forms for its different fellowship programmes.

Applicants should select the programme that matches their academic qualifications and eligibility.

Post Doctoral Fellowship

Candidates interested in the Post Doctoral Fellowship can apply through the application form provided by WSAI.

Post Bacc Fellowship

Candidates applying for the general Post Bacc Fellowship can use the designated application form.

Women Post Bacc Fellowship

Women who meet the requirements for the Women Post Bacc Fellowship can apply through its dedicated application form.

Applicants should carefully review the application form and provide accurate academic and personal information.

APPLY HERE

Tips for Preparing a Strong WSAI Fellowship Application

Although the information provided does not prescribe a specific application strategy, candidates can strengthen their preparation by clearly demonstrating their suitability for research in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.

1. Clearly Explain Your Research Interests

Applicants should be able to explain what areas of Data Science or AI they are interested in and why those areas matter to them.

2. Demonstrate Relevant Academic Preparation

Ensure that your academic background clearly satisfies the relevant programme requirements, particularly the degree requirements for the Post Bacc and Women Post Bacc programmes.

3. Highlight Research Experience

Where applicable, emphasize:

  • Previous research projects
  • Academic projects
  • Publications
  • Conference presentations
  • Technical projects
  • Research internships
  • Relevant coursework
  • Independent research

4. Demonstrate Technical Skills

Candidates working in AI and Data Science can benefit from clearly presenting relevant technical capabilities and experience.

5. Identify Potential Research Directions

For research-oriented applications, having a clear idea of the types of problems you would like to investigate can demonstrate preparation and genuine interest.

6. Review the Programme Carefully

Applicants should distinguish between the Post Doctoral, Post Bacc, and Women Post Bacc programmes before submitting an application.

Choosing the wrong programme based on age, academic level, or eligibility could prevent an otherwise qualified candidate from applying successfully.

Who Qualifies for the WSAI Fellowships?

The eligible applicant category differs according to the fellowship.

Post Doctoral Fellowship

The Post Doctoral Fellowship is aimed at outstanding candidates who hold a PhD in a subject related to Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or allied application domains.

Post Bacc Fellowship

The general Post Bacc Fellowship is intended for exceptional graduates and postgraduates who:

  • Hold a four-year Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree.
  • Have a degree in an area relevant to WSAI.
  • Are under 27 years of age.

Women Post Bacc Fellowship

The Women Post Bacc Fellowship is specifically for women graduates and postgraduates who:

  • Hold a four-year Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree.
  • Have a degree in an area relevant to WSAI.
  • Are under 28 years of age or within the age range encouraged by WSAI.

Eligible Countries and Nationalities

The information provided for these fellowships does not state a restriction to Indian citizens or any specific nationality, race, or continent.

The supplied WSAI fellowship information describes the academic and age requirements but does not specify an eligible-country list.

Therefore, applicants from outside India should check the official application forms and WSAI’s current fellowship guidance to confirm whether there are any nationality, visa, residency, or other international applicant requirements.

Candidates should not assume that nationality restrictions apply unless such restrictions are explicitly stated in the official programme information.

Is There an Application Deadline?

The provided WSAI fellowship information does not give a specific application deadline for the 2026 fellowships.

Applicants interested in these opportunities should therefore check the official WSAI fellowship pages and the relevant application forms for the latest information before applying.

Because fellowship application windows can change, candidates should avoid waiting until the last minute to submit their applications.

Visit HERE to learn more about the WSAI Fellowships 2026 at IIT Madras.

Important Points to Remember

Before applying, prospective candidates should keep the following points in mind:

  1. The Post Doctoral Fellowship requires a PhD in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or an allied application domain.
  2. The Post Bacc Fellowship requires a four-year Bachelor’s or Master’s degree relevant to WSAI.
  3. The general Post Bacc Fellowship specifies an under-27 age requirement.
  4. The Women Post Bacc Fellowship is exclusively for women.
  5. The Women Post Bacc programme specifies that applicants under 28 are encouraged to apply.
  6. The fellowships provide opportunities to work in a research-intensive AI and Data Science environment.
  7. Several programmes offer access to advanced CPU/GPU high-performance computing infrastructure.
  8. Research publication opportunities are highlighted across the Post Bacc programmes.
  9. The Post Bacc programmes include opportunities for fully funded national conference trips.
  10. The Post Doctoral Fellowship includes a monthly stipend of INR 1 lakh, along with additional research and travel allowances.
  11. No specific deadline is provided in the supplied information.
  12. Applicants should use the correct application form for the fellowship they are applying for.
  13. International applicants should verify nationality, visa, and other requirements directly with WSAI because these are not specified in the supplied information.

Frequently Asked Questions About WSAI Fellowships 2026

What is the WSAI Fellowship?

The WSAI Fellowship refers to research fellowship opportunities offered by the Wadhwani School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at IIT Madras. The programmes include Post Doctoral, Post Bacc, and Women Post Bacc opportunities.

Who can apply for the WSAI Post Doctoral Fellowship?

The programme is intended for outstanding candidates with a PhD in a field related to Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or allied application domains.

How much does the WSAI Post Doctoral Fellowship pay?

The Post Doctoral Fellowship includes a monthly stipend of INR 1 lakh, along with additional research and travel allowances.

Can graduates apply for the WSAI Post Bacc Fellowship?

Yes. The Post Bacc Fellowship is designed for exceptional graduates and postgraduates. Applicants should have a four-year Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in an area relevant to WSAI and should be under 27 years of age.

Is there a WSAI fellowship specifically for women?

Yes. WSAI offers the Post Bacc-W Fellowship Program, which is exclusively for women.

What is the age limit for the Women Post Bacc Fellowship?

WSAI states that applicants under 28 years of age are encouraged to apply.

Does WSAI provide computing facilities?

Yes. The fellowship programmes provide access to state-of-the-art CPU/GPU high-performance computing infrastructure.

Can WSAI fellows publish research?

Yes. The Post Bacc programmes highlight opportunities to publish in top journals and A* conferences, with support for publications in top-tier venues.

Does the fellowship provide conference funding?

The Post Bacc and Women Post Bacc programmes include a fully funded trip to a national conference every year.

Is there a deadline for the WSAI Fellowship 2026?

No specific deadline is stated in the information provided. Applicants should check the official WSAI application pages for the latest deadline or application status.

Can international applicants apply?

The provided information does not specify a nationality or country restriction. International applicants should check the official application forms and WSAI guidance for any requirements concerning nationality, international admission, visas, or residency.

Conclusion

The WSAI Fellowships 2026 at IIT Madras present valuable research opportunities for individuals seeking to build careers in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. With separate programmes for postdoctoral researchers, exceptional graduates and postgraduates, and women in the early stages of their research careers, WSAI offers pathways for candidates at different academic stages.

The Post Doctoral Fellowship stands out for experienced researchers with relevant PhDs, offering a monthly stipend of INR 1 lakh, research and travel allowances, faculty mentorship, student mentoring opportunities, international academic exposure, workshops, and access to high-performance computing infrastructure.

The Post Bacc Fellowship provides younger graduates and postgraduates with an opportunity to spend up to two years conducting research, accessing advanced computing resources, interacting with international scientists, pursuing publications, potentially earning IIT Madras course credits, and attending a fully funded national conference each year.

Meanwhile, the Women Post Bacc Fellowship provides a dedicated two-year research pathway for women, combining research opportunities with mentorship from women experts in academia and industry, publication support, advanced computing facilities, conference participation, and exposure to major women-in-computing events.

For candidates with a genuine interest in AI and Data Science, these programmes can offer more than financial or academic support. They can provide an environment for developing research independence, technical expertise, professional networks, publication experience, and long-term scientific leadership.

Interested applicants should carefully review the eligibility criteria, identify the fellowship that corresponds to their academic and career stage, and submit their application through the appropriate WSAI application form. Since no specific deadline is provided in the supplied information, prospective applicants should also verify the current application status and any closing date directly with WSAI before applying.

item.content:encoded:
Are you an experienced professional looking for an opportunity to contribute to international development, social protection, program management, research, learning and regional engagement across the Pacific? The Partnerships for Social Protection (P4SP) program, implemented by DT Global Asia Pacific and commissioned by the Australian Government through the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT), is seeking a qualified Program Officer to support the implementation of major regional activities.

This is a full-time position offering an opportunity to work within a major Australian Government-supported international development program focused on strengthening social protection systems across Pacific nations.

The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting regional program implementation, learning activities, research, communications, monitoring, evaluation, reporting, logistics and stakeholder engagement. The position is particularly suitable for professionals who have experience in international development, project or program management, communications, social policy, research, training or related disciplines.

The contract is expected to run from January 2027 until September 2029, providing the successful candidate with a long-term opportunity to contribute to a significant regional development initiative.

Importantly, this is a remote home-based role, although the successful candidate may occasionally be required to attend DT Global office locations and participate in domestic and international travel within Australia and the Pacific region.

Applications officially close at 5:00 PM AEST on 21 September 2026.

Overview of the DT Global P4SP Program Officer Position

The Program Officer will support the implementation and coordination of regional activities under the Partnerships for Social Protection program.

The role involves working closely with the Deputy Team Leader, the Communications and Public Diplomacy Manager, activity leads, consultants, government partners and other members of the P4SP and DT Global teams.

A major component of the position involves supporting learning and knowledge-sharing activities. This includes helping to develop, coordinate and deliver:

  • Online learning sessions;
  • In-person training activities;
  • E-learning materials;
  • Internal learning events;
  • Brown bag lunches;
  • Workshops and planning activities;
  • Research initiatives;
  • Regional engagement activities; and
  • Other knowledge-sharing opportunities.

The Program Officer will also contribute to program management processes, monitoring and evaluation activities, planning, reporting, communications, procurement support and event coordination.

This makes the position highly multidisciplinary and particularly valuable for professionals seeking to build or expand their careers in international development and Pacific regional programming.

Key Job Details

Position Program Officer
Employment Type Full-time
Contract Period January 2027 to September 2029
Work Arrangement Remote/home-based
Possible Locations Fiji, Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne or Adelaide
Travel Domestic and international travel may be required
Reporting To Deputy Team Leader
Application Deadline 21 September 2026, 5:00 PM AEST
Program Partnerships for Social Protection (P4SP)
Implementing Organisation DT Global Asia Pacific

About DT Global Asia Pacific

DT Global Asia Pacific is an international development organisation that works across Asia and the Pacific to support governments, communities and stakeholders in addressing complex development challenges.

The organisation focuses on developing locally led and sustainable solutions that contribute to improved social, economic and environmental outcomes.

With more than 1,500 staff and experts working across more than 22 countries, DT Global brings together technical expertise and regional experience to deliver initiatives across a broad range of sectors.

Its work includes areas such as:

  • Inclusive economic growth;
  • Essential public services;
  • Governance;
  • Justice systems;
  • Climate resilience;
  • Infrastructure development;
  • Social equity;
  • Community resilience;
  • Security; and
  • Sustainable development.

DT Global has more than six decades of development experience and works in partnership with governments, communities, institutions and other stakeholders to address national and transnational development challenges.

The organisation places significant emphasis on collaboration, innovation and long-term impact.

The Program Officer joining P4SP will therefore become part of a wider network of development professionals working on initiatives across Asia and the Pacific.

About the Partnerships for Social Protection (P4SP) Program

The Partnerships for Social Protection program, commonly known as P4SP, is an Australian Government-supported international development initiative focused on strengthening social protection systems across Pacific nations.

The program was commissioned by the Australian Government through the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) and is implemented by DT Global.

P4SP is an eight-year program with a total value of AUD 36 million.

The initiative supports governments across Pacific countries to strengthen their national social protection systems and improve the ability of social protection policies and programs to reach people who need support.

The program commenced on 20 September 2021 and will operate until 19 September 2029.

P4SP works through both bilateral and regional activities.

Its work focuses on helping government partners improve the:

  • Quality of social protection systems;
  • Inclusiveness of social protection programs;
  • Sustainability of national systems;
  • Coverage of vulnerable populations;
  • Delivery of social protection policies;
  • Awareness of social protection;
  • Demand for inclusive and effective services; and
  • Capacity of governments and institutions working in the sector.

A key outcome of the program is to support governments in increasingly addressing gaps and bottlenecks affecting the coverage and inclusiveness of social protection policies and program delivery.

The program operates within a highly adaptive and demand-driven environment. This means that activities are influenced by the priorities and needs of partner governments and Australian Government representatives in participating countries.

As a result, professionals working with P4SP have an opportunity to engage with a dynamic regional development environment and contribute to initiatives that respond to evolving needs across Pacific communities.

What Is the Purpose of the Program Officer Role?

The central purpose of the Program Officer position is to support the implementation of P4SP regional activities.

The successful candidate will contribute to activities related to:

  • Learning;
  • Research;
  • Stakeholder engagement;
  • Program coordination;
  • Communications;
  • Monitoring and evaluation;
  • Reporting;
  • Event management; and
  • Knowledge sharing.

The role provides an opportunity for the successful candidate to gain deeper knowledge and practical experience in the area of social protection.

Social protection is becoming increasingly important within international development because governments and development partners are seeking stronger systems that can protect vulnerable populations, respond to economic and social shocks and improve inclusion.

Through involvement in the regional portfolio, the Program Officer will gain exposure to development programming across the Pacific while supporting initiatives designed to improve government capacity and social protection outcomes.

Major Responsibilities of the Program Officer

The Program Officer will have a broad range of responsibilities covering program management, coordination, learning, research, communications and administration.

1. Supporting Program Management

A major responsibility of the successful candidate will be supporting the efficient management of P4SP regional activities.

This includes supporting activities connected to:

  • Learning;
  • Research;
  • Communications;
  • Events;
  • Monitoring;
  • Evaluation;
  • Research;
  • Learning and adaptation.

The Program Officer will assist activity leads and other team members in ensuring that program components are effectively coordinated and implemented.

This may involve monitoring activity progress, maintaining planning tools, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring that important information is accurately documented.

2. Coordinating Program Activities

The successful candidate will support the coordination and implementation of key regional activities and program components.

Working under the guidance of relevant activity leads, the Program Officer may help ensure that activities move efficiently from planning to implementation.

This requires strong organisational abilities and the capacity to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to coordination processes while ensuring that deadlines, responsibilities and deliverables are appropriately tracked.

3. Supporting E-Learning Development

One of the particularly important areas of responsibility involves supporting the development of e-learning materials.

The Program Officer will work with:

  • Consultants;
  • Technical specialists;
  • P4SP team members; and
  • Other relevant stakeholders.

The successful candidate may assist in coordinating the development of digital learning resources designed to support knowledge sharing and capacity development.

This responsibility makes the position particularly relevant for applicants with experience in:

  • Digital learning;
  • Training coordination;
  • Educational content development;
  • Communications;
  • Digital content management; and
  • Online program delivery.

4. Supporting Learning and Training Activities

The position has a significant learning and capacity-building component.

The Program Officer will support the coordination and delivery of learning activities, including both virtual and physical sessions.

Potential activities may include:

  • Online training sessions;
  • In-person workshops;
  • Learning events;
  • Internal knowledge-sharing sessions;
  • Brown bag lunches;
  • Professional development activities; and
  • Other regional learning initiatives.

Applicants with previous experience coordinating workshops, training programs, webinars or knowledge-sharing events may therefore have an advantage.

5. Maintaining Program Management Tools and Trackers

Effective program management requires accurate and up-to-date information.

The Program Officer will support the maintenance of important program management tools and trackers.

These may include:

  • Activity trackers;
  • Tasking notes;
  • Contract trackers;
  • Planning tools;
  • Budget monitoring tools; and
  • Other program management records.

Attention to detail will therefore be essential.

The successful candidate must be able to manage information accurately and ensure that key documents remain current.

6. Providing Secretariat and Meeting Support

The Program Officer will provide secretariat support for meetings and events when required.

This may include assisting with:

  • Developing meeting agendas;
  • Preparing presentations;
  • Coordinating logistical arrangements;
  • Communicating with participants;
  • Drafting emails;
  • Managing mailing lists;
  • Sending invitations;
  • Managing RSVPs;
  • Circulating meeting minutes;
  • Coordinating feedback; and
  • Taking minutes during meetings.

This aspect of the role requires excellent written communication and strong administrative skills.

Applicants should be comfortable communicating professionally with a wide range of stakeholders.

7. Supporting Reports and Program Documentation

The successful candidate will contribute to the drafting and finalisation of important program documents.

These may include:

  • Reports;
  • Program plans;
  • Briefing materials;
  • Terms of Reference;
  • Publications; and
  • Other technical or administrative documents.

Strong writing and editing abilities will therefore be highly valuable.

The position is suitable for professionals who can communicate complex information clearly and contribute to high-quality written materials.

8. Supporting Procurement Processes

The Program Officer may also contribute to the procurement of goods and services.

This will involve working with activity leads and operational teams to support timely procurement processes.

The successful candidate may need to assist with coordination and documentation while ensuring that procurement activities align with relevant organisational procedures.

9. Supporting Internal Program Activities

The successful candidate may assist the Senior Management Team with coordinating important whole-of-program activities.

These could include:

  • Reflect and Refocus Workshops;
  • Internal learning events;
  • Planning sessions; and
  • Other major program coordination activities.

This responsibility provides exposure to higher-level program management processes and strategic planning.

10. Conducting Desk-Based Research

The Program Officer may undertake small-scale desk-based research when required.

Research activities could support program planning, learning initiatives, technical discussions or the development of reports and publications.

Candidates with strong research and analytical skills may therefore find this role particularly suitable.

The ability to identify reliable information, analyse evidence and communicate findings clearly will be valuable.

11. Supporting Budget Monitoring

The position also involves supporting activity leads in ensuring that activity budgets remain accurate and up to date.

The Program Officer may contribute to:

  • Budget tracking;
  • Financial planning;
  • Forecasting;
  • Reporting; and
  • Monitoring expenditure against planned activities.

Applicants should therefore demonstrate strong organisational and analytical abilities.

12. Supporting Records Management

Maintaining effective records is an important component of international development programming.

The Program Officer will support proper records management and ensure that relevant program information and documentation are appropriately maintained.

This requires strong attention to detail and an organised approach to information management.

13. Contributing to Planning and Reporting

The successful candidate will contribute to P4SP-wide planning and reporting activities.

This may involve working with different members of the program team to compile information, track progress and support the preparation of program reports.

The role provides valuable exposure to how large international development programs plan, monitor and report on their activities.

14. Participating in Technical Discussions

The Program Officer will participate in technical team meetings and discussions.

This provides an opportunity to engage with development specialists and contribute to conversations relating to social protection and regional development.

The successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate curiosity, professionalism and a willingness to learn.

15. Participating in Country Visits

Depending on program requirements, the successful candidate may participate in in-country visits.

Travel may take place within Australia and the Pacific region.

This can provide valuable practical exposure to development contexts and engagement with government partners and stakeholders.

Leadership and Organisational Culture Expectations

Beyond technical responsibilities, the Program Officer will be expected to contribute positively to the organisational culture of P4SP and DT Global.

The successful candidate should demonstrate professional behaviour and a collaborative approach to work.

Key expectations include:

  • Participating actively in team discussions;
  • Contributing to team activities;
  • Seeking learning and professional development opportunities;
  • Building constructive relationships;
  • Working effectively with colleagues and partners;
  • Demonstrating professionalism;
  • Promoting P4SP values;
  • Identifying and communicating potential risks early; and
  • Seeking support when necessary.

The position emphasises a “one team” approach involving collaboration between:

  • P4SP;
  • DT Global;
  • DFAT;
  • Consultants;
  • Government partners; and
  • Other stakeholders.

Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively across different professional and cultural environments will therefore be important.

Eligibility Criteria for the DT Global P4SP Program Officer Position

Applicants must meet several educational, professional and technical requirements.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must hold a bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline.

Relevant fields include:

  • International development;
  • Social policy;
  • Public policy;
  • Project management;
  • Communications; or
  • Another closely related discipline.

Candidates with academic backgrounds that provide relevant knowledge and skills for program coordination and international development may also be considered.

Professional Experience Requirement

Applicants must have a minimum of three years of relevant work experience.

Relevant experience may include work in areas such as:

  • Program management;
  • Project coordination;
  • International development;
  • Social policy;
  • Research;
  • Communications;
  • Monitoring and evaluation;
  • Learning and development;
  • Training coordination;
  • Event management; or
  • Related professional fields.

Technical Skills Required

Applicants should demonstrate proficiency in relevant workplace and program management tools.

The position specifically requires proficiency in:

  • Microsoft Office;
  • Microsoft Excel;
  • Smartsheet; and
  • Canva.

These requirements indicate that the successful candidate should be comfortable managing information, preparing documents, tracking activities and contributing to communication or learning materials.

Communication Skills

Strong verbal and written English communication skills are essential.

The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Draft professional correspondence;
  • Support report writing;
  • Prepare program documents;
  • Communicate with participants and stakeholders;
  • Take meeting minutes; and
  • Contribute to presentations and publications.

Applicants should therefore demonstrate the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.

Knowledge of International Development

Candidates should have an understanding of international development.

While applicants are not necessarily required to be specialists in social protection, an understanding of development programming and international development contexts will be valuable.

The role offers an opportunity to deepen knowledge of social protection while working alongside experienced development professionals.

Program Management Skills

Applicants should have experience and skills related to program management.

Important capabilities include:

  • Planning;
  • Coordination;
  • Activity tracking;
  • Reporting;
  • Budget monitoring;
  • Stakeholder engagement; and
  • Managing multiple priorities.

Personal and Professional Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • Flexibility;
  • Adaptability;
  • Strong time management;
  • Excellent teamwork;
  • Professionalism;
  • Independence;
  • Attention to detail;
  • Organisational skills; and
  • The ability to work effectively without constant supervision.

Because this is primarily a remote home-based role, the ability to work independently is particularly important.

Desirable Qualifications and Experience

While not mandatory, several types of experience will strengthen an application.

These include:

Experience in Learning and Training Programs

Candidates with experience developing or supporting training and learning initiatives may have an advantage.

Relevant experience could include:

  • Training coordination;
  • Workshop facilitation;
  • E-learning;
  • Webinar management;
  • Capacity building; and
  • Professional development programs.

Experience with DFAT-Funded Programs

Experience working on Australian Government-funded development programs or activities may be beneficial.

Applicants familiar with DFAT-funded programming may already understand some of the requirements, standards and operating environments associated with Australian international development initiatives.

Knowledge of Social Protection

Knowledge of social protection within international development contexts is desirable.

Social protection can include policies and programs designed to support vulnerable populations and improve economic and social resilience.

Candidates with academic or professional experience related to social policy, poverty reduction, welfare systems or inclusion may find their backgrounds particularly relevant.

Pacific Region Experience

Experience working in a Pacific country is considered desirable.

Candidates with knowledge of Pacific development contexts, cultures, institutions and government systems may bring valuable regional insights to the role.

Remote Work Experience

Because the position is home-based, previous experience working remotely is desirable.

Applicants should demonstrate that they can:

  • Manage their time independently;
  • Communicate effectively online;
  • Coordinate with distributed teams;
  • Meet deadlines;
  • Participate in virtual meetings; and
  • Maintain productivity outside a traditional office environment.

Where Can the Successful Candidate Be Based?

The Program Officer position is designed as a remote home-based role.

However, the position may be based in one of the following locations:

  • Fiji;
  • Brisbane;
  • Sydney;
  • Melbourne; or
  • Adelaide.

The location may also be flexible for the right candidate.

Although the role is primarily remote, the successful candidate may occasionally be required to attend DT Global office locations.

The position may also require some:

  • Interstate travel;
  • Domestic travel; and
  • International travel within Australia and the Pacific region.

Candidates should therefore be prepared for occasional travel requirements.

Important Residency and Work Permit Requirements

One of the most important eligibility requirements relates to residency and work authorisation.

Applicants must have either:

  • Australian residency;
  • Fijian residency; or
  • A current valid work permit for the location where they are based.

Applicants are responsible for providing evidence of their current work authorisation.

This means that candidates who do not have the required residency status or legal right to work in the relevant location may not be eligible unless they already possess an appropriate work permit.

Prospective applicants should carefully review this requirement before applying.

Background Checks and Employment Conditions

The successful candidate will be required to meet several employment and compliance conditions.

These include obtaining:

  • National and/or international police clearance;
  • Relevant background screening;
  • Employment verification;
  • Medical clearance; and
  • Other due diligence requirements determined by DT Global.

Some of these checks may need to be renewed periodically.

The successful applicant will also be required to complete mandatory training programs as advised by the organisation.

The position may occasionally require work outside normal working hours, including some weekend work.

DT Global’s Commitment to Safeguarding

DT Global places significant emphasis on safeguarding and maintaining safe environments for the people and communities connected to its operations.

Safeguarding includes protecting:

  • Children;
  • Vulnerable groups;
  • Program beneficiaries;
  • Partners;
  • Government stakeholders; and
  • Organisational personnel.

The organisation has a zero-tolerance approach toward:

  • Sexual exploitation;
  • Sexual abuse;
  • Harm against adults and children;
  • Fraud;
  • Corruption;
  • Bribery;
  • Modern slavery; and
  • Other forms of exploitation.

Successful candidates are expected to uphold high standards of integrity and professional conduct.

All personnel are required to align their work with DT Global’s organisational values, safeguarding principles and compliance requirements.

Diversity and Equal Employment Opportunity

DT Global is committed to creating an inclusive work environment and providing equal employment opportunities.

The organisation encourages applications from diverse candidates who meet the requirements of the position.

In particular, the organisation strongly encourages applications from:

  • Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people;
  • Female applicants; and
  • People with disabilities.

Applicants who require support or accessibility accommodations during the application process are encouraged to communicate these requirements when applying.

Why Apply for the DT Global P4SP Program Officer Position?

This position offers several professional advantages for qualified candidates interested in international development and regional programming.

1. Long-Term Contract Opportunity

The role runs from January 2027 until September 2029.

This provides the successful candidate with an opportunity to contribute to a significant program over an extended period.

2. Remote Work Arrangement

The position is primarily home-based.

This may provide greater flexibility compared to a fully office-based position, although occasional in-person attendance and travel may be required.

3. International Development Experience

The successful candidate will gain practical experience working within a major international development program.

This can be particularly valuable for professionals seeking to develop careers with:

  • International development organisations;
  • Government agencies;
  • Multilateral institutions;
  • NGOs;
  • Development consultancies; and
  • Regional organisations.

4. Exposure to Pacific Regional Development

The role provides an opportunity to engage with development issues affecting Pacific countries.

The successful candidate can develop a stronger understanding of regional development priorities and social protection systems.

5. Learning and Professional Development

The position involves significant engagement with learning activities, research and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

The successful candidate will also be encouraged to seek opportunities to develop new skills and knowledge.

6. Multidisciplinary Professional Experience

The role combines multiple areas of professional practice, including:

  • Program management;
  • Research;
  • Communications;
  • Learning;
  • Training;
  • Event management;
  • Monitoring and evaluation;
  • Reporting; and
  • Stakeholder coordination.

This multidisciplinary exposure can strengthen a professional’s future career opportunities.

How to Apply for the DT Global P4SP Program Officer Job

Interested and eligible candidates should submit their applications through the official DT Global recruitment platform.

Applicants are instructed to click the “Apply Now” option on the official job advertisement.

Apply for the DT Global P4SP Program Officer position

Before submitting an application, candidates should carefully review the position requirements and ensure that they clearly demonstrate their relevant qualifications and professional experience.

Applicants should particularly highlight experience related to:

  • International development;
  • Program management;
  • Project coordination;
  • Learning and training;
  • Research;
  • Communications;
  • Stakeholder engagement;
  • Remote collaboration;
  • Event coordination;
  • Reporting;
  • Microsoft Office and Excel;
  • Smartsheet; and
  • Canva.

Candidates can also review the official Terms of Reference for a more comprehensive understanding of the position.

APPLY HERE

Application Deadline

The deadline for submitting applications is: 5:00 PM AEST, 21 September 2026.

Applicants are strongly encouraged not to wait until the final day to submit their applications. Early preparation can provide sufficient time to review eligibility requirements, update application documents and address any technical challenges with the online recruitment platform.

Tips for a Strong Application

Candidates interested in this opportunity should tailor their application specifically to the responsibilities outlined in the job description.

A strong application should demonstrate clear evidence of the following:

Program Coordination Experience

Provide examples of projects, programs or activities you have helped coordinate.

Strong Communication Skills

Highlight experience writing reports, briefs, emails, publications or other professional documents.

Learning and Training Experience

If applicable, demonstrate experience supporting:

  • Workshops;
  • Training sessions;
  • Webinars;
  • E-learning;
  • Knowledge-sharing events; or
  • Capacity-building initiatives.

Digital and Technical Skills

Clearly mention experience using tools such as:

  • Microsoft Office;
  • Excel;
  • Smartsheet;
  • Canva; and
  • Other relevant digital collaboration platforms.

Remote Work Capability

Demonstrate your ability to work independently, manage deadlines and collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams.

International Development Knowledge

Where applicable, explain your understanding of international development issues and your interest in contributing to development outcomes.

Attention to Detail

Because the role involves trackers, reporting, planning and records management, candidates should demonstrate strong organisational and administrative capabilities.

Visit HERE to learn more about the DT Global P4SP Program Officer Job 2027–2029.

Conclusion

The DT Global P4SP Program Officer position presents a significant career opportunity for experienced professionals seeking to work in international development, program management and regional engagement across the Pacific.

As part of the Australian Government-supported Partnerships for Social Protection program, the successful candidate will contribute to an initiative focused on helping Pacific governments strengthen the quality, coverage, inclusiveness and sustainability of their social protection systems.

The position offers a diverse range of responsibilities, including program coordination, learning and training support, research, communications, event management, reporting, monitoring and stakeholder engagement.

With a full-time contract running from January 2027 to September 2029, the opportunity provides substantial professional exposure for candidates interested in building long-term careers in international development.

Applicants with a relevant bachelor’s degree, at least three years of professional experience, strong communication and program management skills, and the required Australian or Fijian residency or work authorisation should carefully consider applying.

Eligible candidates should ensure they submit a well-tailored application before the official deadline of 5:00 PM AEST on 21 September 2026.
